traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Saprobic fungus notable for its star-shaped fruiting body. The fruit body consists of a central spore sac that sits atop a base of radiating arms (rays), which split open and curve backwards as the fungus matures, resembling a star. The outer peridium (outer layer) is finely fimbriate (fringed) along the edges. The inner spore sac is sessile or nearly so, containing the gleba, which produces a brown spore print.
